hard_stops: Any unexplained B0/B1/B2 numerical, packet, controller-mutation or controlled chronology/RK4 discrepancy
Nonfinite or invalid model/actuator/grip state, numerical-domain failure, recorded boundary crossing or predicted slack >1e-6 m
Unexplained solver/prediction/preparation/gain failure, unexpected fallback, lost/expired authority or exhaustion in a run described as successful
Future-truth leakage, overlapping solve, changed event order, concealed missed deadline or erased old-command provenance
Timer double counting, unreconciled/negative residual beyond reviewed clock allowance, missing spans silently replaced by zero, recorder overflow or lost outcomes
Missing context/recoverability, provenance mismatch, unexpected resource/backend/thread behavior or conflicting measurement guard
Budget/headroom exhausted: stop starting new workers; retain partial attempt and censoring, never delete evidence or rerun for a favorable result
negative_fixture_rule: Predeclared test injections intentionally exercise failure/late/expiry paths and must match the uninstrumented oracle. A new unexplained scientific failure stops the affected branch; review, not an automatic repair/retune/replacement, decides next work.
scope_limits: No Phase A implementation or execution in this delivery

safety_reference.rule: Three distinct gates: feasible proposal, accepted trajectory authority, application permission. S0 is a proposed specification, not installed recovery or endpoint enforcement; S1 remains independent.

delivery: Documentation-only scoped checks then normal commit/push to research/efficiency; final exact delivery SHA/URL outside tracked self-hash. Stop at WORK_COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW.
